steps: A held actual geometry response preserves focused unfinished input and never renders an unchecked shape. Checked initial geometry renders saved viewport and all three logical actors. A real CDP mouse click selects the sensor; Enter on the accessible body button selects the wall. Neither operation changes draft or author bytes.

Changing shape to circle, radius to 12 and offset X to 2 clears the scene view until Check succeeds. The checked view places the circle at saved actor (100,180) plus offset (2,0). Selecting another body preserves the reviewed candidate and Apply authority. BOM, CRLF, escaped key, numeric spelling and untouched body slices remain exact.

An external edit in the disposable saved scene moves the character beyond the viewport. Refresh updates only its observed world position, fits the offscreen bounds and preserves exact numeric input node, focus, selection and checked review. Restoring the scene and refreshing restores the geometry without changing the physics candidate.

At 390px, Chinese, English and Japanese preserve the focused body button, existing field nodes, checked review and Apply authority. SVG keeps circle proportions; dialog and page avoid horizontal overflow and all footer actions remain visible.

A real transport failure clears only the optional scene view, exposes a retry message, and preserves fields, checked candidate and Apply authority. Retry restores the geometry without creating or cancelling an edit.

Removing the sensor from the disposable saved scene produces an explicit missing-target body button and no invented shape position. Selecting it opens its preserved instance ID for repair. The readonly observation does not alter review authority; the existing target directory still owns Apply membership checks. Restoring the scene restores its sensor geometry.

Closing with an HTTP geometry response held discards only the temporary form. Reopening starts a new source observation; releasing the old response cannot replace the reopened checked shape or fields.

Apply changes only the ordinary source draft; reopening displays its checked collision geometry over saved actor positions. Cancel keeps that draft. Ordinary Save changes only the exact reviewed physics source, preserving BOM, CRLF, escaped key and untouched body text. No resource bytes are fetched.

GUI Plan, Build and real Godot headless Run consume the saved circle radius 12 and local offset X 2. Character stops at x≈131; actual sensor enter/exit publishes the other instance UUID from its sensor binding. Animation completes idle/action/idle under unchanged project protocol 10.
